frontmatter.name: tsrpc-api
frontmatter.description: Use when creating new TSRPC API endpoints, adding new functionality, or implementing request-response interfaces. Triggers on phrases like "create API", "add endpoint", "implement interface", "new service"

frontmatter.name: tsrpc-flow
frontmatter.description: Use when adding middleware, implementing authentication, encryption, logging, request interception, or response transformation. Triggers on phrases like "add middleware", "authentication", "logging", "intercept request", "validate token"

frontmatter.name: tsrpc-msg
frontmatter.description: Use when implementing real-time messaging, WebSocket communication, chat systems, or pub/sub patterns. Triggers on phrases like "send message", "broadcast", "real-time", "WebSocket message", "chat"

frontmatter.name: tsrpc-db
frontmatter.description: Use when setting up database connections, creating CRUD APIs, designing data models, or working with MongoDB in TSRPC. Triggers on phrases like "database", "MongoDB", "CRUD", "collection", "data model"
